newsitem.title: USA: U.S. barge rates - Lightly quoted on call.
newsitem.headline: U.S. barge rates - Lightly quoted on call.

text.p: U.S. barge rates were lightly quoted Tuesday on the St. Louis Merchants Exchange call session, the Exchange said.
No barges traded verus none on Monday.
- One barge, Mount Vernon, Ohio River, on station, offered at 150 percent of tariff, no bid or comparison.
- One barge, Peoria, Illinois River, on station, offered at 170 percent, no bid or comparison.
- Two barges, Illinois, week of March 16, bid at 150 percent, offered at 160 percent, no comparison.
- Four barges, mid-Mississippi River, one each week April, offered at 160 percent, no bid or comparison.
- Four barges, Illinois, one each week April, offered at 145 percent, no bid or comparison.
- Four barges, mid-Mississippi, one each week May, offered at 150 percent, no bid or comparison.
